verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator: physics, rendering, simulated sensor generation, and transport between simulation server and GUI. Capturing telemetry on physical robots and syncing it to the cloud under bandwidth-aware policies belongs to a different product role, such as a fleet data or observability platform, so the axis does not apply. Its simulated sensor output and gz-transport pub/sub are simulation and building-block features, not an on-robot cloud-sync capability.
